meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会检查你的LazyCodex和Codex CLI安装是否健康：先同步最新官方源码，再对比本地版本、插件、配置和运行结果，最后输出一份PASS/WARN/FAIL报告，每条结论都附有命令输出或文件证据。诊断过程中不会改动你的安装或配置。
howto.when: 当你说“医生”或“健康检查”，提到LazyCodex等关键词，或报告Codex在安装/更新/改配置后行为异常、怀疑配置过期损坏时触发。

say.text: 帮我的LazyCodex做一次健康检查
say.note: 它会同步最新源码并输出诊断报告

say.text: 看看我的Codex CLI是不是装坏了
say.note: 它会运行探测并对比最新版本

say.text: 审计一下我的Codex配置有没有过期
say.note: 它会比对配置与最新安装器的写法

howto.what_en: As a doctor, Claude checks LazyCodex/Codex CLI health: syncs latest sources, compares local versions/plugins/config/runtime, then outputs a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence per verdict. It never writes to your install or config.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'doctor' or 'health check', mention LazyCodex or related keywords, or report Codex acting oddly after install/update/config change, suspect a stale or broken setup.

say_en.text: Run a health check on my LazyCodex installation.
say_en.note: It syncs latest sources and prints a report.

say_en.text: Check if my Codex CLI is broken.
say_en.note: It probes and compares against latest versions.

say_en.text: Audit my Codex config for staleness.
say_en.note: It compares config to the latest installer.
